summary: Iteration 3 frontend-only targeted retest. Verified (1) Comparateur detail dialog fix ('F is not defined' resolved), (2) new 'Produits examinés' tab + use-offer-btn flow adding specific offers with composite keys code@fournisseur, (3) Estimateur calc using examined offer prices, (4) non-regression on 'Prix retenus' tab. All 4 targeted scenarios passed.

issues: React a11y warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby on Radix DialogContent. Non-blocking but should add DialogDescription for accessibility compliance.

action_items: Optional: add <DialogDescription> to DialogContent components to silence Radix a11y warnings.

estimateStore.js addOffer uses composite key `${code}@${fournisseur}` — clean separation from addItem, prevents collision. Good.
Catalogue.jsx: use-offer-btn added inside offers table; row click stopPropagation on the '+' add button is correct.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 validated: Comparateur detail dialog now opens without crash (F helper defined).
